name: Ansagan Islamgaliev
title: Senior Full-Stack .NET & React Engineer
elevatorPitch: I design and build fast, maintainable, and scalable full-stack web applications across .NET, React, and TypeScript.
summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 4+ years building enterprise software in C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, React and Azure, currently for Chevron and Tengizchevroil. I modernize legacy applications: moving .NET Framework services to .NET 8, fixing slow screens, making web apps work offline for 500+ field staff, and speeding up release pipelines. Before software, I spent 6 years in oil & gas field operations.

experience.summary: Core engineer in Chevron's Central Agile Team driving Turnaround (TA) Progress and Turnover Notes digitalization across web, mobile PWAs, and BFF microservices.
